summary: Improve task risk ratings, environmental assessments and control reviews with practical EHS training. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: EHS risk assessment helps safety, environmental and operations professionals identify hazards and document consistent controls. Designed for EHS officers, supervisors and risk analysts, the course covers practical task assessments and environmental records, including likelihood and consequence scoring, job safety analysis, bow-tie barrier reviews, aspect-impact registers, residual-risk checks and action prioritisation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already encounter workplace hazards or environmental impacts and need to make their assessments more consistent, traceable and usable by operational teams.
modules: Job Safety Analysis for Task Hazards
prerequisites: Prior experience with workplace safety, environmental controls or operational risk records is recommended. No programming is required. You should be able to discuss work activities or assessment records relevant to your role.
